ticket_number_extraction.description: No printed ticket number exists on Challis Redi-Mix tickets. Do not use the Recalled ID#. ticket_number is always null. A unique identifier is generated after extraction using the format 'CHALLIS-[MMDDYYYY]-[net_tons]' (e.g. 'CHALLIS-06022026-11.04') and used for duplicate detection and Excel entry.

notes.ticket_number: No printed ticket number. Do not use the Recalled ID#. ticket_number is null. A unique identifier is generated from date and net_tons using the format 'CHALLIS-[MMDDYYYY]-[net_tons]' and used for duplicate detection and Excel entry.
notes.date: The printed date in the weigh-out section (typically '01/01/10') is a placeholder and must be ignored. The real date is handwritten and circled elsewhere on the ticket. Formats vary: '6-2-26', '6.2.2026', '06-02-2026'. Convert to MM/DD/YYYY.
notes.facility: Always 'Challis Redi-Mix' — there is no separate quarry/facility field on this ticket.
notes.material: From the 'Commodity:' field. Strip the customer name appended after the material (e.g. 'Rip Rap MJ Hughes' → 'Rip Rap').
notes.net_tons: Value after the 'Tons' label at the bottom of the weigh-out section. If any weight values are crossed out or have a line through them, ignore those values entirely and use only the clean uncrossed value.
notes.helper_notes: Always include 'No ticket number - ID generated from date and tonnage' in Helper Notes. If the ticket also includes a note such as 'no ticket' for additional witnessed loads, append that as well.
notes.excel_columns: A=Ticket Date, B=Logged Date, C=Facility (always 'Challis Redi-Mix'), D=Material, E=Ticket # (generated CHALLIS-[MMDDYYYY]-[net_tons] identifier), F=Net TN, G=Helper Notes, H=Human Notes (leave blank)

ai_extraction_prompt: This is a Challis Redi-Mix rock ticket. There is no ticket number on Challis Redi-Mix tickets. Do not use the Recalled ID#. Return ticket_number as null. The printed date in the weigh-out is always wrong (placeholder 01/01/10) - find the real handwritten date which is circled or written separately on the ticket, formatted like 6-2-26 or 6.2.2026. If any weight values are crossed out, ignore them completely and only extract clean uncrossed values. Some tickets may have a note like 'no ticket' for additional witnessed loads - include this in Helper Notes.
